warnings.headline: Rain Yellow Warning for Bosnia and Herzegovina - region Mostar
warnings.description: Accumulated rain between 20 and 40 l/m2.
warnings.instruction: Be aware of the possibility of local flooding of a small number of properties, with local disruption to outdoor activities. Difficult driving conditions due to reduced visibility and uncontrolled movement of vehicles due to water.
warnings.sender: Hydrometeorological Institute of Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
